SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
ORDER BY 
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
WHERE 
    ptc.name_zh = '现金支取'
    AND pe.amount > 5000000
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC;

SELECT p.party_id, pp.annual_income
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY pp.annual_income DESC;

SELECT 
    pc.card_id,
    pc.issued_on,
    pc.expires_on
FROM 
    payment_card pc
JOIN 
    card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE 
    ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
ORDER BY 
    pc.issued_on ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    op.operating_status
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ou.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
    AND op.registered_region = (
        SELECT op_inner.registered_region
        FROM party p_inner
        JOIN organization_profile op_inner ON p_inner.party!party_id = op_inner.party_id
        JOIN organization_unit ou_inner ON p_inner.home_org_unit_id = ou_inner.org_unit_id
        JOIN institution i_inner ON ou_inner.institution_id = i_inner.institution_id
        WHERE i_inner.institution_name = '上海分行'
        LIMIT 1
    )
ORDER BY 
    p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM 
    organization_unit ou
JOIN 
    account a ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    account_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.sector_name_zh,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY 
    i.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.fair_value), 2) AS total_fair_value
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
WHERE 
    phs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_id, wp.product_name
ORDER BY 
    total_fair_value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(pr.relation_id) AS relation_count
FROM 
    party_relation pr
JOIN 
    party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    relation_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cs.net_capital,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets
FROM 
    capital_snapshot cs
JOIN 
    institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    cs.net_capital DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(abs.ledger_balance), 2) AS total_deposit_balance
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN 
    account_balance_snapshot abs ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
WHERE 
    a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
    AND abs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_deposit_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days), 2) AS avg_principal_overdue_days
FROM 
    delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    ROUND(AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days), 2) > 90
ORDER BY 
    avg_principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS exposure_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS exposure_ratio
FROM 
    exposure_group eg
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN 
    party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    institution inst ON eg.institution_id = inst.institution_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON inst.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
ORDER BY 
    exposure_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS total_loan_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('SUBSTANDARD', 'DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS npl_count,
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('SUBSTANDARD', 'DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(ld.loan_id),
        6
    ) AS npl_ratio
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
LEFT JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id 
    AND rc.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM risk_classification 
        WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    i.sector_code, i.sector_name_zh
HAVING 
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 20
ORDER BY 
    npl_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT 
    risk_level,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count,
    ROUND(AVG(management_fee_rate), 4) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM 
    wealth_product
GROUP BY 
    risk_level
ORDER BY 
    risk_level ASC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_balance
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment g
JOIN 
    party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    g.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) > 500000000
ORDER BY 
    total_guaranteed_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE 
    rtc.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) > 300000000
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(dse.record_id) AS record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(dse.observed_value), 2) AS total_observed_value
FROM 
    data_security_event_v3 dse
JOIN 
    institution i ON dse.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    dse.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_observed_value DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_count
FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE r.completion_date IS NULL 
   OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY overdue_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM 
    capital_snapshot cs
JOIN 
    institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cs.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY 
    capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan!id = rc.loan_id
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    ds.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM delinquency_snapshot 
        WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
    AND rc.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM risk_classification 
        WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
    AND ds.principal_overdue_days > 90
    AND cg.grade_name_zh IN ('正常', '关注')
ORDER BY 
    ds.principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount THEN lbs.principal_balance ELSE 0 END), 2) AS insufficient_provision_balance
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount THEN lbs.principal_balance ELSE 0 END) > 100000000
ORDER BY 
    insufficient_provision_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    p.display_name AS payee_name,
    ind.sector_name_zh,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    party p ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE 
    ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
    AND pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
ORDER BY 
    pi.in!instruction_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pe.amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS non_compliant_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pe.amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(pe.amount), 6) AS ratio
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    account a_to ON pe.to_account_id = a_to.account_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON a_to.account_id = ah.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN 
    party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
JOIN 
    institution i ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = (
        SELECT org_unit_id FROM organization_unit WHERE org_unit_id = pe.origin_org_unit_id
    )
WHERE 
    pe.status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_id,
    ma.maturity_on AS asset_maturity_date,
    wp.actual_termination_on AS product_termination_date
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE 
    wp.status = 'TERMINATED'
    AND ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY 
    ma.maturity_on DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantee_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS borrower_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) > 0 
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) > 0
ORDER BY 
    guarantee_count DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    ptc.name_zh AS payment_type_name,
    pe.amount,
    ou.unit_name AS org_unit_name
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1
    AND pe.amount > 5000000.0
    AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    op_ind.sector_name_zh AS borrower_industry_name,
    ca_ind.sector_name_zh AS target_industry_name,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector op_ind ON op.industry_code = op_ind.sector_code
JOIN industry_sector ca_ind ON ca.target_industry_code = ca_ind.sector_code
WHERE ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.target_industry_code != op.industry_code
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    ah_p.party_id AS payer_party_id,
    ah_b.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account_holder ah_p ON pe.from_account_id = ah_p.account_id AND ah_p.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN account_holder ah_b ON pe.to_account_id = ah_b.account_id AND ah_b.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party_relation pr ON ah_p.party_id = pr.source_party_id AND ah_b.party_id = pr.target_party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN status_catalog sc ON pe.status = sc.status_code AND sc.entity = 'payment'
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND sc.name_zh = '已清算'
  AND rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
  AND pr.effective_to IS NULL
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ou.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1
    AND pe.amount > 5000000.0
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY 
    total_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sm.staff_id,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN 
    account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON to_acc.account_id = ah.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN 
    party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector isc ON op.industry_code = isc.sector_code
WHERE 
    isc.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
GROUP BY 
    sm.staff_id
ORDER BY 
    transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    cdd.record_id,
    i.institution_name,
    cdd.event_date,
    cdd.deadline_date,
    ROUND(JULIANDAY('2026-06-30') - JULIANDAY(cdd.deadline_date), 2) AS days_overdue
FROM 
    customer_due_diligence_event_v3 cdd
JOIN 
    institution i ON cdd.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cdd.completion_date IS NULL
    AND cdd.deadline_date <= '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY 
    days_overdue DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.status AS collateral_status,
    sa.status AS security_status
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN 
    collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'RELEASED' 
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    sa.security_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ca.agreement_id,
    sa.security_id,
    so.covered_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE 
    ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    so.covered_amount DESC;

WITH RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.institution_id 
            ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
        ) as rn
    FROM institution i
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    loan_id,
    ROUND(principal_balance, 2) as principal_balance,
    rn as balance_rank
FROM RankedLoans
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        op.industry_code,
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        lb.industry_code,
        lb.loan_id,
        lb.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lb.industry_code ORDER BY lb.principal_balance DESC) as rn
    FROM loan_balances lb
)
SELECT 
    isec.sector_name_zh,
    rl.loan_id,
    ROUND(rl.principal_balance, 2) as principal_balance,
    rl.rn
FROM ranked_loans rl
JOIN industry_sector isec ON rl.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE rl.rn <= 3
ORDER BY isec.sector_name_zh ASC, rl.rn ASC;

SELECT 
    business_date,
    daily_count,
    daily_count - LAG(daily_count, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS count_change
FROM (
    SELECT 
        business_date,
        COUNT(*) AS daily_count
    FROM payment_event
    GROUP BY business_date
)
ORDER BY business_date ASC;

WITH institution_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ROUND(AVG(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS avg_principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ia.avg_principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - ia.avg_principal_balance, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN institution_avg ia ON ca.institution_id = ia.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > ia.avg_principal_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
LEFT JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
WHERE 
    cl.collateral_id IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 
    sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 31
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 91
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 181
        ELSE 361
    END AS overdue_interval_start,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM delinquency_snapshot d
WHERE d.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 31
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 91
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 181
        ELSE 361
    END
ORDER BY overdue_interval_start ASC;

SELECT

SELECT

WITH relation_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        ah_src.account_id AS src_account_id,
        ah_tgt.account_id AS tgt_account_id,
        inst.institution_id,
        inst.institution_name
    FROM party_relation pr
    JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
    JOIN party p_src ON pr.source_party_id = p_src.party_id
    JOIN party p_tgt ON pr.target_party_id = p_tgt.party_id
    JOIN account_holder ah_src ON p_src.party_id = ah_src.party_id AND ah_src.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
    JOIN account_holder ah_tgt ON p_tgt.party_id = ah_tgt.party_id AND ah_tgt.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
    JOIN account acc_src ON ah_src.account_id = acc_src.account_id
    JOIN institution inst ON acc_src.institution_id = inst.institution_id
    WHERE rtc.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
),
transaction_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(acc_from.institution_id, acc_to.institution_id) AS inst_id,
        SUM(pe.amount) AS total_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM relation_pairs rp 
            WHERE rp.src_account_id = pe.from_account_id 
              AND rp.tgt_account_id = pe.to_account_id
        ) THEN pe.amount ELSE 0 END) AS related_amount
    FROM payment_event pe
    LEFT JOIN account acc_from ON pe.from_account_id = acc_from.account_id
    LEFT JOIN account acc_to ON pe.to_account_id = acc_to.account_id
    LEFT JOIN institution inst_from ON acc_from.institution_id = inst_from.institution_id
    LEFT JOIN institution inst_to ON acc_to.institution_id = inst_to.institution_id
    GROUP BY COALESCE(acc_from.institution_id, acc_to.institution_id)
)
SELECT 
    inst.institution_name AS institution_name,
    ROUND(ts.related_amount, 2) AS related_transaction_amount,
    ROUND(ts.total_amount, 2) AS total_transaction_amount,
    ROUND(ts.related_amount * 1.0 / NULLIF(ts.total_amount, 0), 6) AS ratio
FROM transaction_stats ts
JOIN institution inst ON ts.inst_id = inst.institution_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT

    payment_card pc ON p.party_id = pc.holder_party_id
JOIN 
    card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
JOIN 
    term_deposit td ON p.party_id = (
        SELECT ah.party_id 
        FROM account_holder ah 
        WHERE ah.account_id = td.account_id 
        LIMIT 1
    )
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND ctc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
    AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) > 0 
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) > 0
ORDER BY 
    term_deposit_count DESC;

SELECT

WITH loan_balances AS (

),
ranked_loans AS (

    FROM loan_balances
)
SELECT

    quartile_group

ORDER BY quartile_group ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC

WITH industry_loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        op.industry_code,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY op.industry_code
),
industry_with_name AS (
    SELECT 
        ilb.industry_code,
        isec.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
        ilb.total_balance
    FROM industry_loan_balances ilb
    JOIN industry_sector isec ON ilb.industry_code = isec.sector_code
),
total_balance AS (
    SELECT SUM(total_balance) AS grand_total FROM industry_with_name
),
cumulative_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        iwn.industry_name,
        iwn.total_balance AS balance_sum,
        SUM(iwn.total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY iwn.total_balance DESC) AS cumulative_balance,
        tb.grand_total
    FROM industry_with_name iwn
    CROSS JOIN total_balance tb
)
SELECT 
    industry_name,
    ROUND(balance_sum, 2) AS balance_sum,
    ROUND(cumulative_balance * 1.0 / grand_total, 6) AS cumulative_ratio
FROM cumulative_calc
WHERE (cumulative_balance * 1.0 / grand_total) <= 0.8
ORDER BY cumulative_ratio ASC;

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT

WITH loan_balances AS (

        ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
institution_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        ROUND(AVG(principal_balance), 2) AS avg_balance
    FROM loan_balances
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    lb.loan_id,
    lb.principal_balance,
    ia.avg_balance,
    ROUND(lb.principal_balance - ia.avg_balance, 2) AS excess_diff
FROM loan_balances lb
JOIN institution_avg ia ON lb.institution_id = ia.institution_id
JOIN institution i ON lb.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE lb.principal_balance > 2 * ia.avg_balance
ORDER BY excess_diff DESC;

WITH all_exposures AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
),
non_related_exposures AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS non_related_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id NOT IN (
        SELECT pr.source_party_id
        FROM party_relation pr
        JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
        WHERE rtc.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    )
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
)
SELECT 
    ae.institution_name,
    COALESCE(nre.non_related_amount, 0.0) AS non_related_amount,
    ae.total_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(nre.non_related_amount, 0.0) * 1.0 / ae.total_amount, 6) AS ratio
FROM all_exposures ae
LEFT JOIN non_related_exposures nre ON ae.institution_id = nre.institution_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
FROM 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    cs.net_capital
HAVING 
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) > 0.10
ORDER BY 
    concentration_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH industry_avg_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.target_industry_code,
        ROUND(AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate), 4) AS avg_industry_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL 
      AND ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.target_industry_code
)
SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS execution_rate,
    ROUND(iar.avg_industry_rate, 4) AS industry_avg_rate,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - iar.avg_industry_rate) * 100.0 / iar.avg_industry_rate, 2) AS markup_percent
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_avg_rates iar ON ca.target_industry_code = iar.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND (ca.annual_interest_rate - iar.avg_industry_rate) * 100.0 / iar.avg_industry_rate > 10.0
ORDER BY markup_percent DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS exceed_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        i.institution_id,
        cs.net_capital,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM 
        institution i
    JOIN 
        capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
    JOIN 
        credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    JOIN 
        loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN 
        loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN 
        party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    WHERE 
        cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
        AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
        AND p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
        AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY 
        i.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id, cs.net_capital
    HAVING 
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) > (cs.net_capital * 0.10)
) sub
JOIN 
    institution i ON sub.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    exceed_count DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS total_balance,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
FROM 
    exposure_group eg
JOIN 
    institution inst ON eg.institution_id = inst.institution_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON eg.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN 
    party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
CROSS JOIN 
    (SELECT as_of_date FROM capital_snapshot WHERE institution_id = (SELECT institution_id FROM exposure_group LIMIT 1) ORDER BY as_of_date DESC LIMIT 1) latest_snap
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = latest_snap.as_of_date
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING 
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) > 0.10
ORDER BY 
    concentration_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.maturity_on,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.status AS loan_status,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'MATURED'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS days_between
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    payment_event pe ON ld.disbursement_account_id = pe.from_account_id
WHERE 
    pe.payment_type = 'TRANSFER'
    AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
    AND pe.business_date >= ld.disbursed_on
    AND CAST(julianday(pe.business!_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) <= 7
    AND CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) >= 0
ORDER BY 
    days_between ASC,
    pe.amount DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH CapitalSnapshots AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM capital_snapshot cs2 
        WHERE cs2.institution_id = capital_snapshot.institution_id
    )
),
LoanBalances AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        op.party_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(lbs.principal_balance, 0)) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
        AND lbs.as_of_date = (
            SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
            FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
            WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
        )
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, op.party_id
),
Ratios AS (
    SELECT 
        lb.institution_id,
        lb.party_id,
        ROUND(lb.total_principal * 1.0 / NULLIF(cs.net_capital, 0), 6) AS ratio_val
    FROM LoanBalances lb
    JOIN CapitalSnapshots cs ON lb.institution_id = cs.institution_id
),
RankedRatios AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        party_id,
        ratio_val,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY institution_id ORDER BY ratio_val DESC) AS rn
    FROM Ratios
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    rr.ratio_val
FROM RankedRatios rr
JOIN institution i ON rr.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON rr.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE rr.rn = 1
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.institution_id ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS quartile
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY 
    quartile ASC,
    lbs.principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 100.0 / SUM(lbs.principal_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.institution_id), 2) AS percentage
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id)
ORDER BY 
    i.institution_name ASC,
    percentage DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    ld.status,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ds.total_overdue_principal, 0.0), 2) AS total_overdue_principal,
    ds.overdue_installment_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        loan_id,
        SUM(overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal,
        COUNT(*) AS overdue_installment_count
    FROM delinquency_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM delinquency_snapshot)
    GROUP BY loan_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
) ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ds.overdue_installment_count >= 2
ORDER BY ds.overdue!_installment_count DESC, ds.total_overdue_principal DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    loan_account_id,
    disbursed_on,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown
GROUP BY 
    loan_account_id,
    disbursed_on
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT ah.party_id
FROM account_holder ah
JOIN term_deposit td ON ah.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ah.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY ah.party_id ASC;

SELECT p.party_id
FROM party p
JOIN staff_member sm ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
LEFT JOIN account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'STAFF'
  AND sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ah.account_holder_id IS NULL
ORDER BY p.party_id ASC;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (
    SELECT pe.from_account_id
    FROM payment_event pe
    JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
    WHERE ptc.payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    security_id, 
    guaranteed_amount
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment
WHERE 
    status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY 
    guaranteed_amount DESC;

WITH loan_maturity AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.current_maturity_on,
        CAST(julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') AS INTEGER) AS days_remaining
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
),
categorized_loans AS (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        CASE
            WHEN days_remaining < 0 THEN '已到期'
            WHEN days_remaining >= 0 AND days_remaining <= 90 THEN '临期'
            ELSE '常态'
        END AS maturity_bucket
    FROM loan_maturity
)
SELECT
    maturity_bucket AS bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM categorized_loans
GROUP BY maturity_bucket
ORDER BY
    CASE maturity_bucket
        WHEN '常态' THEN 1
        WHEN '临期' THEN 2
        WHEN '已到期' THEN 3
    END;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS link_count
FROM 
    collateral_link cl
JOIN 
    collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE 
    sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY 
    link_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_type AS 押品种类,
    ROUND(AVG(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS 平均评估价值,
    COUNT(*) AS 评估笔数
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement cag ON so.agreement_id = cag.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON cag.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cv.appraiser_kind = 'INTERNAL'
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY 
    平均评估价值 DESC;

WITH account_loan_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.repayment_account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ld.repayment_account_id ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on, ld.loan_id) AS rn
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ld.repayment_account_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
),
filtered_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        als.repayment_account_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.disbursed_on,
        ld.disbursed_amount,
        als.total_loans,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY als.repayment_account_id ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on, ld.loan_id) AS seq
    FROM account_loan_stats als
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON als.repayment_account_id = ld.repayment_account_id
    WHERE als.rn <= 2
)
SELECT 
    repayment_account_id,
    loan_id,
    disbursed_on,
    disbursed_amount,
    total_loans
FROM filtered_loans
WHERE seq <= 2
ORDER BY repayment_account_id, disbursed_on;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount, 2) AS excess_amount,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS drawdown_count
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING 
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY 
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count,
    ROUND(SUM(abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance), 2) AS total_difference
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    account_balance_snapshot abs ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    abs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND abs.ledger_balance > abs.available_balance
    AND (abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance) > 5000000.0
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_difference DESC;

SELECT 
    td.account_id,
    td.opening_principal,
    td.maturity_on,
    td.annual_interest_rate
FROM 
    term_deposit td
JOIN 
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    td.maturity_on <= '2026-06-30'
    AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    td.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT 
    pc.card_id,
    ctc.name_zh AS card_type_name,
    pc.issued_on
FROM 
    payment_card pc
JOIN 
    card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE 
    pc.card_type = 'DEBIT'
    AND pc.issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
    AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    pc.issued_on ASC,
    pc.card_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_entrusted_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'SELF_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_self_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 6) AS entrusted_ratio
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 6) < 0.52
ORDER BY 
    entrusted_ratio ASC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    SUM(ld2.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) AS total_contract_disbursement,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / SUM(ld2.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) * 100.0, 2) AS single_disbursement_ratio_pct
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld2 ON ld.agreement_id = ld2.agreement_id
GROUP BY 
    ld.loan_id, ld.agreement_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ca.agreement_id
HAVING 
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 1!0 / SUM(ld2.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) * 100.0, 2) > 90.00
ORDER BY 
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS actual_raise_total,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS planned_raise_total,
    ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0), 6) AS completion_rate
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    institution i ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name
HAVING 
    completion_rate > 1.2
ORDER BY 
    completion_rate DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs_overdue.installment_id IS NOT NULL THEN ld_overdue.loan_id END) AS overdue_loan_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld_all.loan_id) AS total_loan_count
FROM party p
JOIN loan_drawdown ld_all ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld_all.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld_overdue ON ca.agreement_id = ld_overdue.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN repayment_schedule rs_overdue ON ld_overdue.loan_id = rs_overdue.loan_id AND rs_overdue.status = 'OVERDUE'
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs_overdue.installment_id IS NOT NULL THEN ld_overdue.loan_id END) > 0
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT ld_all.loan_id) > COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs_overdue.installment_id IS NOT NULL THEN ld_overdue.loan_id END)
ORDER BY overdue_loan_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    p_borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p_payee.display_name AS actual_payee_name,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p_borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id =! p_borrower.party_id
LEFT JOIN 
    party p_payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p_payee.party_id
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
    AND pi.intended_payee_party_id IS NOT NULL
    AND ca.borrower_party_id != pi.intended_payee_party_id
ORDER BY 
    pi.instruction_amount DESC,
    pi.instruction_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.signed_on,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE 
    ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY 
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS unpaid_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_principal_due
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE 
    ld.loan_id NOT IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT rs_inner.loan_id
        FROM repayment_schedule rs_inner
        WHERE rs_inner.status = 'PAID'
    )
GROUP BY 
    ld.loan_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) > 0
ORDER BY 
    total_principal_due DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND lbs.principal_balance > 10000000
ORDER BY 
    lbs.principal_balance DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ld.loan_account_id,
    a.opened_on
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    account a ON ld.loan_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY 
    ld.disbursed_on ASC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id AS loan_account_id,
    a.account_kind,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
ORDER BY 
    ld.disbursed_amount DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.security_type,
    ca.contract_amount,
    p.display_name
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    ca.security_type = 'CREDIT'
    AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000.0
ORDER BY 
    ca.contract_amount DESC,
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

WITH non_related_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.agreement_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.product_family,
        ca.annual_interest_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN party_relation pr ON ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
    WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
      AND ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
),
institution_product_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        product_family,
        ROUND(AVG(annual_interest_rate), 4) AS avg_rate
    FROM non_related_loans
    GROUP BY institution_id, product_family
)
SELECT 
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p.party_id AS party_id,
    ROUND(nl.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS contract_rate,
    ipa.avg_rate AS avg_product_rate,
    ROUND(nl.annual_interest_rate - ipa.avg_rate, 4) AS rate_spread
FROM non_related_loans nl
JOIN institution_product_avg ipa 
    ON nl.institution_id = ipa.institution_id 
    AND nl.product_family = ipa.product_family
JOIN party p ON nl.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE nl.annual_interest_rate < ipa.avg_rate
ORDER BY rate_spread DESC;

SELECT 
    pr.source_party_id AS party_a_id,
    pr.target_party_id AS party_b_id,
    rtc.relation_name_zh AS relation_name
FROM 
    party_relation pr
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld_a ON pr.source_party_id = (
        SELECT ca.borrower_party_id 
        FROM credit_agreement ca 
        WHERE ca.agreement_id = ld_a.agreement_id
    )
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld_b ON pr.target_party_id = (
        SELECT ca.borrower_party_id 
        FROM credit_agreement ca 
        WHERE ca.agreement_id = ld_b.agreement_id
    )
WHERE 
    pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    AND rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
ORDER BY 
    rtc.relation_name_zh ASC,
    pr.relation_id ASC;

SELECT 
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_loan_balance,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
FROM 
    exposure_group eg
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN 
    party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id 
    AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON eg.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    eg.effective_from <= '2026-06-30' 
    AND (eg.effective_to IS NULL OR eg.effective_to >= '2026-06-30')
    AND egm.effective_from <= '2026-06-30' 
    AND (egm.effective_to IS NULL OR egm.effective_to >= '2026-06-30')
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 
    eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 2
    AND (SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) > 0.1
ORDER BY 
    concentration_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    payer_party.display_name AS payer_name,
    payee_party.display_name AS payee_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transfer_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account from_acc ON pe.from_account_id = from_acc.account_id
JOIN account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah_payer ON from_acc.account_id = ah_payer.account_id
JOIN party payer_party ON ah_payer.party_id = payer_party.party_id
JOIN account_holder ah_payee ON to_acc.account_id = ah_payee.account_id
JOIN party payee_party ON ah_payee.party_id = payee_party.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON payer_party.party_id = pr.source_party_id AND payee_party.party_id = pr.target_party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE pe.payment_type = 'TRANSFER'
  AND rtc.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY payer_party.display_name, payee_party.display_name
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
  AND wp.risk_level = 'R5'
  AND phs.investment_path = 'NESTED_SPV'
  AND phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
ORDER BY wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT 
    product_id, 
    COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM 
    product_holding_snapshot
WHERE 
    investment_path = 'NESTED_SPV'
GROUP BY 
    product_id
ORDER BY 
    asset_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    lds.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) AS max_overdue_days
FROM 
    loan_drawdown lds
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lds.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON lds.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE 
    lbs.principal_balance > 90000000
    AND ds.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY 
    lds.loan_id, lbs.principal_balance
HAVING 
    MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) >= 200
ORDER BY 
    max_overdue_days DESC, lds.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) AS institution_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM 
    exposure_group eg
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON egm.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY 
    eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    institution_count DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS overdue_member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON egm.party_id = (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id 
    FROM credit_agreement ca 
    WHERE ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS enterprise_name,
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 0), 2) AS total_external_guarantee,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 0), 2) AS total_own_loan,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 0), 2) AS guarantee_loan_diff
FROM party p
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
    AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, 
    p.display_name
HAVING 
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > SUM(ca.contract_amount)
ORDER BY 
    guarantee_loan_diff DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    sm.staff_id AS employee_id,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS agreement_count
FROM 
    staff_member sm
JOIN 
    party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON sm.person_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE 
    sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    p.display_name, sm.staff_id
ORDER BY 
    agreement_count DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name,
    p.party_id,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
    pp.annual_income,
    ROUND(ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS multiple
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON p.party_id = (
        SELECT ca.borrower_party_id 
        FROM credit_agreement ca 
        WHERE ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    )
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
    AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
HAVING 
    ROUND(ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) > 2.0
ORDER BY 
    multiple DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    sm.staff_id AS operator_id,
    so.authority_level AS authority_level,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS self_loan_contract_count

    party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id

    service_operator so ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE 
    so.operator_kind = 'CREDIT_OPERATOR'
    AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    p.display_name, sm.staff_id, so.authority_level
ORDER BY 
    self_loan_contract_count DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    ld.disbursed_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account_holder ah ON ld.disbursement_account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN party_type_catalog ptc ON p.party_type = ptc.party_type
WHERE ptc.party_type = 'STAFF'
  AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p.party_id AS![](https://via.placeholder.com/15/000000/000000.png) borrower_id,
    pp.annual_income AS annual_income,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due), 2) AS total_due_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) * 1.0 / NULLIF(pp.annual_income, 0), 2) AS income_multiple
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
    AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income

    p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT 
    lpc.product_name_zh AS product_category_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status =! 'PAID' THEN rs.principal_due ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    repayment_schedule rs
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_product_catalog lpc ON ld.drawdown_type = lpc.product_code
WHERE 
    rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY 
    lpc.product_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 END) AS expired_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' AND td.maturity_on <= date('2026-!-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 END) AS due_90_days_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on > date('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 END) AS due_over_90_days_count
FROM 
    term_deposit td
JOIN 
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 END) >= 20
ORDER BY 
    expired_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ah.account_id) AS joint_account_count
FROM 
    account_holder ah
JOIN 
    account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT ah.party_id) > COUNT(DISTINCT ah.account_id)
ORDER BY 
    joint_account_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS overdue_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON ca.managing_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, 
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    rs.loan_id,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    repayment_schedule rs
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE 
    rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
    AND rs.principal_due > 0
GROUP BY 
    rs.loan_id
HAVING 
    SUM(rs.principal_due) > 120000000.0
ORDER BY 
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN rs.interest_due ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS total_overdue_interest
FROM 
    repayment_schedule rs
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30
ORDER BY 
    overdue_installment_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM 
    repayment_schedule rs
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY 
    overdue_loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    rs.loan_id,
    rs.installment_no,
    rs.principal_due,
    rs.interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
  AND rs.principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY rs.principal_due DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    cs.net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) AS disbursement_to_capital_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON cf.facility_id = ca.facility_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM capital_snapshot 
        WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING 
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > cs.net_capital
ORDER BY 
    disbursement_to_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount

    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE 
    sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING 
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS total_limit_amount
FROM

JOIN 
    institution i ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name, cf.facility_type
HAVING

ORDER BY

SELECT 
    cf.facility_type,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM

    cf.limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY

ORDER BY

SELECT 
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh,

JOIN 
    payment_mode_catalog pmc ON ld.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode

WITH ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        actual_raise_amount,
        minimum_holding_days,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS group_seq
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = 'ON_SALE'
),
group_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        group_seq,
        COUNT(*) AS product_count
    FROM ranked_products
    WHERE minimum_holding_days > 0
    GROUP BY group_seq
    HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 31 AND 33
)
SELECT 
    group_seq,
    product_count
FROM group_stats
ORDER BY group_seq ASC;

SELECT

    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id

ORDER BY 
    total_limit DESC;

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT

    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS credit_manager_count

GROUP BY

ORDER BY

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    ds.overdue_principal
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan!id = ds.loan_id
WHERE 
    ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ds.principal_overdue_days > 30
    AND cg.grade_code = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY 
    ds.principal_overdue_days DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS insufficient_provision_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE 
    ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ps.provision_stage = 'STAGE_2'
    AND ps.recognized_amount > 0
    AND ps.required_amount > 0
    AND (ps.recognized_amount * 1.0 / ps.required_amount) < 0.5
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    insufficient_provision_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount), 2) AS provision_gap_total
FROM 
    provision_snapshot p
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    p.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    provision_gap_total DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.account_subtype,
    ROUND(ABS.balance, 2) AS ledger_balance
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    account_balance_snapshot ABS ON a.account_id = ABS.account_id

    account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'

    AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
    AND ah.account_holder_id IS NULL
    AND ABS.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM account_balance_snapshot 
        WHERE account_id = a.account_id
    )
ORDER BY 
    ABS.balance DESC;

SELECT p.customer_segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.annual_income > 1000000

ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT
