   ![]()ma.asset_category_primary ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    pp.annual_income,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS debt_service_ratio
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON p.party_id = cf.obligor_party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
    AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, pp.annual_income
HAVING 
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) > 3.0
ORDER BY 
    debt_service_ratio DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    pp.occupation_code,
    pp.employment_sector,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM 
    person_profile pp
JOIN 
    party p ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY 
    pp.occupation_code,
    pp.employment_sector
ORDER BY 
    customer_count DESC,
    pp.occupation_code ASC,
    pp.employment_sector ASC;

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'DEBIT'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY card_count DESC, status ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN 
    party p ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
JOIN 
    payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
WHERE 
    ctc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
    AND pe.is_cash = 1
    AND (pe.payment_type = 'CASH_DEPOSIT' OR pe.payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL')
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    total_amount DESC, ou.unit_name ASC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pc.card_id,
    pc.holder_party_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE ctc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id ASC, pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    pc.holder_party_id,
    COUNT(*) AS cash_transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM 
    payment_card pc
JOIN 
    payment_event pe ON pc.card_id = pe.from_account_id OR pc.settlement_account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN 
    card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
JOIN 
    payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
WHERE 
    ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
    AND ptc.name_zh IN ('现金存入', '现金支取')
GROUP BY 
    pc.holder_party_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY 
    cash_transaction_count DESC, 
    total_amount DESC;

SELECT holder_party_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card
GROUP BY holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY card_count DESC, holder_party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    c.name_zh AS card_type_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(AVG(p.amount), 2) AS avg_single_amount
FROM 
    payment_event p
JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON (p.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id OR p.to_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id)
JOIN 
    card_type_catalog c ON pc.card_type = c.card_type
WHERE 
    c.card_type IN ('CREDIT', 'DEBIT')
    AND p.payment_type IN ('CASH_DEPOSIT', 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL')
GROUP BY 
    c.name_zh
ORDER BY 
    avg_single_amount DESC,
    c.name_zh ASC;

SELECT 
    channel,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM 
    payment_event
WHERE 
    status = 'SETTLED'
    AND is_cash = 0
GROUP BY 
    channel
HAVING 
    ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) > 11780000.00
ORDER BY 
    avg_amount DESC, 
    channel ASC;

SELECT 
    td.account_id,
    td.maturity_on,
    a.status
FROM 
    term_deposit td
JOIN 
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    td.maturity_on <= '2026-06-30'
    AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    td.maturity_on DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(MAX(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS max_valuation_amount
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE 
    ca.collateral_id IN (
        SELECT collateral_id
        FROM collateral_valuation
        GROUP BY collateral_id
        HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
    )
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
ORDER BY 
    max_valuation_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS reference_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS distinct_security_count
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE' 
    AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING 
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    reference_count DESC, 
    ca.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name,
    ca.agreement_id,
    ROUND(gc.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS guaranteed_amount,
    ROUND(ld.total_disbursed_amount, 2) AS total_disbursed_amount
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON gc.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            ld_inner.agreement_id,
            SUM(ld_inner.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount
        FROM 
            loan_drawdown ld_inner
        JOIN 
            credit_agreement ca_inner ON ld_inner.agreement_id = ca_inner.agreement_id
        WHERE 
            ld_inner.status = 'ACTIVE'
        GROUP BY 
            ld_inner.agreement_id
    ) ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE 
    gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND gc.guaranteed_amount > ld.total_disbursed_amount
ORDER BY 
    gc.guaranteed_amount DESC,
    gc.g!guarantor_party_id ASC,
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.borrower_party_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) AS total_covered_amount,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) AS coverage_gap
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND so.effective_to IS NULL
    AND sa.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.borrower_party_id,
    ca.contract_amount
HAVING 
    coverage_gap > 0
ORDER BY 
    coverage_gap DESC,
    ca.agreement_id ASC
LIMIT !100;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS insufficient_provision_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
    JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
    JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
WHERE 
    cg.grade_code = 'SUBSTANDARD'
    AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
    AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    insufficient_provision_count DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.borrower_party_id AS debtor_party_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS loan_balance,
    ca.contract_amount AS credit_limit,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS balance_multiple
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ca.contract_amount > 0
    AND (lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount) >= 4.0
ORDER BY 
    balance_multiple DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS over_provision_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.recognized_amount - ps.required_amount), 2) AS total_over_provision_amount
FROM 
    risk_classification rc
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON rc.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
WHERE 
    cg.is_nonperforming = 1
    AND ps.recognized_amount > ps.required_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    total_over_provision_amount DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC,
    cg.grade_name_zh ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(max_internal.valuation_amount, 2) AS max_internal_valuation,
    ROUND(max_external.valuation_amount,! 2) AS max_external_valuation,
    ROUND(max_internal.valuation_amount - max_external.valuation_amount, 2) AS undervaluation_diff
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            collateral_id, 
            MAX(valuation_amount) AS valuation_amount
        FROM 
            collateral_valuation
        WHERE 
            valuation_type = 'INTERNAL'
        GROUP BY 
            collateral_id
    ) max_internal ON ca.collateral_id = max_internal.collateral_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            collateral_id, 
            MAX(valuation_amount) AS valuation_amount
        FROM 
            collateral_valuation
        WHERE 
            valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL'
        GROUP BY 
            collateral_id
    ) max_external ON ca.collateral_id = max_external.collateral_id
WHERE 
    max_external.valuation_amount < max_internal.valuation_amount
ORDER BY 
    undervaluation_diff DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(cv.valuation_amount, 2) AS latest_valuation,
    ROUND(SUM(cl.pledged_amount), 2) AS total_pledged_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(cl.pledged_amount) - cv.valuation_amount, 2) AS coverage_gap
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE 
    cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cv.valued_on = (
        SELECT MAX(cv_inner.valued_on)
        FROM collateral_valuation cv_inner
        WHERE cv_inner.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, cv.valuation_amount, cv.valued_on
HAVING 
    SUM(cl.pledged_amount) > cv.valuation_amount
ORDER BY 
    coverage_gap DESC;

WITH borrower_guarantors AS (
    SELECT 
        p.party_id,
        p.display_name
    FROM party p
    INNER JOIN credit_agreement ca_borrow ON p.party_id = ca_borrow.borrower_party_id
    INNER JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
    WHERE ca_borrow.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY p.party_id, p!display_name
),
own_loan_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_own_loan
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
guarantee_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guarantee
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
)
SELECT 
    bg.party_id AS guarantor_id,
    bg.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ROUND(olt.total_own_loan, 2) AS own_loan_total,
    ROUND(gt.total_guarantee, 2) AS guarantee_total
FROM borrower_guarantors bg
JOIN own_loan_totals olt ON bg.party_id = olt.borrower_party_id
JOIN guarantee_totals gt ON bg.party_id = gt.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gt.total_guarantee > olt.total_own_loan
ORDER BY gt.total_guarantee DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    ROUND(sa.secured_amount, 2) AS secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE 
    sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING 
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT p.customer_segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.is_public_official = 1
  AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    rtc.relation_name_zh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM 
    exposure_group eg
JOIN 
    institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON eg.group_type = rtc.relation_type
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name, 
    rtc.relation_name_zh
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY 
    member_count DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM 
    exposure_group_member egm
JOIN 
    party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    group_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS relation_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id OR p.party_id = pr.target_party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE rtc.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) > 0
ORDER BY relation_count DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE 
    rtc.relation_type = 'SHADOW_SHAREHOLDER'
    AND rtc.relation_name_zh = '影子股东'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    group_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_src.agreement_id) AS source_loan_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_tgt.agreement_id) AS target_loan_count
FROM 
    party_relation pr
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca_src ON pr.source_party_id = ca_src.borrower_party_id AND ca_src.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca_tgt ON pr.target_party_id = ca_tgt.borrower_party_id AND ca_tgt.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE 
    pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    AND pr.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    pr.relation_id, pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id
ORDER BY 
    (source_loan_count + target_loan_count) DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ca.collateral_type
FROM collateral_asset ca
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM collateral_link cl
      WHERE cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
        AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  )
ORDER BY ca.collateral_id ASC;

WITH guarantor_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS own_loan_exposure
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ca.borrower_party_id IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT guarantor_party_id 
          FROM guarantor_commitment 
          WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
      )
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
guarantor_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(guaranteed_amount) AS total_guarantee_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment
    WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY guarantor_party_id
),
party_info AS (
    SELECT party_id, display_name FROM party
)
SELECT 
    gt.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_id,
    pi.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ROUND(gt.total_guarantee_amount, 2) AS total_guarantee_liability,
    ROUND(COALESCE(gl.own_loan_exposure, 0), 2) AS own_loan_exposure,
    ROUND(gt.total_guarantee_amount - COALESCE(gl.own_loan_exposure, 0), 2) AS excess_guarantee_amount
FROM guarantor_totals gt
JOIN party_info pi ON gt.guarantor_party_id = pi.party_id
LEFT JOIN guarantor_loans gl ON gt.guarantor_party_id = gl.borrower_party_id
WHERE (gt.total_guarantee_amount - COALESCE(gl.own_loan_exposure, 0)) > 0
ORDER BY excess_guarantee_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    gc.guaranteed_amount,
    gc.status
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN 
    party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
ORDER BY 
    gc.guaranteed_amount DESC,
    p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ma.obligor_party_id = (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id 
    FROM credit_agreement ca 
    JOIN loan_drawdown ldd ON ca.agreement_id = ldd.agreement_id 
    WHERE ldd.loan_id = ds.loan_id
    LIMIT 1
)
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld_self ON ma.obligor_party_id = (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id 
    FROM credit_agreement ca 
    JOIN loan_drawdown ldd ON ca.agreement_id = ldd.agreement_id 
    WHERE ldd.loan_id = ds.loan_id
    LIMIT 1
) AND ld_self.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id 
    FROM credit_agreement ca 
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = ma.obligor_party_id 
    AND ca.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
)
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, ma.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY wp.product_name ASC, total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_type,
    COUNT(sa.security_id) AS security_count,
    ROUND(SUM(so.covered_amount), 2) AS total_covered_amount
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_type
ORDER BY 
    total_covered_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_collateral.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_guarantor.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so_collateral ON ca.agreement_id = so_collateral.agreement_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa_collateral ON so_collateral.security_id = sa_collateral.security_id
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON sa_collateral.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN 
    collateral_asset ca_collateral ON cl.collateral_id = ca_collateral.collateral_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so_guarantor ON ca.agreement_id = so_guarantor.agreement_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa_guarantor ON so_guarantor.security_id = sa_guarantor.security_id
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment ca_guarantor ON sa_guarantor.security_id = ca_guarantor.security_id
WHERE 
    sa_collateral.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND sa_guarantor.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND ca_collateral.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND ca_guarantor.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_collateral.collateral_id) > 0
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT ca_guarantor.commitment_id) > 0
ORDER BY 
    ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON egm.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE eg.effective_from <= '2026-06-30'
  AND (eg.effective_to IS NULL OR eg.effective_to >= '2026-06-30')
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value), 2) AS total_inversion_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS inversion_count
FROM
    product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN
    wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
WHERE
    phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name
HAVING
    SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY
    total_inversion_amount DESC,
    wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    ROUND(phs.carrying_amount, 2) AS carrying_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(lds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN 
    party issuer_party ON ma.issuer_party_id = issuer_party.party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON issuer_party.party_id = (
        SELECT ca.borrower_party_id 
        FROM credit_agreement ca 
        JOIN loan_drawdown ldd ON ca.agreement_id = ldd.agreement_id 
        WHERE ldd.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lds ON ld.loan_id = lds.loan_id
WHERE 
    phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
    AND wp.issuer_institution_id = (
        SELECT institution_id FROM institution WHERE institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
    )
    AND lds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND lds.overdue_principal > 0
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, phs.lookthrough_depth, phs.carrying_amount, phs.holding_id
ORDER BY 
    phs.lookthrough_depth DESC, phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_priority_active_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_ratio_count
FROM 
    collateral_link cl
JOIN 
    collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE 
    cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cl.lien_priority = 1
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    high_ratio_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.total_assets, 2) AS total_assets,
    ROUND(fs.total_liabilities, 2) AS total_liabilities,
    ROUND(fs.net_assets, 2) AS net_assets,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue, 2) AS annual_revenue
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    fs.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.total_liabilities * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 4) AS debt_to_asset_ratio
FROM 
    financial_snapshot fs
JOIN 
    institution i ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE 
    fs.total_assets > 0
ORDER BY 
    debt_to_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.tier1_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS core_tier1_ratio
FROM 
    capital_snapshot cs
JOIN 
    institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM capital_snapshot 
        WHERE institution_id = cs.institution_id
    )
    AND cs.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY 
    core_tier1_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS capital_to_asset_ratio
FROM 
    capital_snapshot cs
JOIN 
    institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND fs.total_assets > 0
ORDER BY 
    capital_to_asset_ratio DESC;

WITH total_revenue AS (
    SELECT SUM(fs.annual_revenue) AS sum_revenue
    FROM financial_snapshot fs
    JOIN institution i ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
    WHERE fs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM financial_snapshot)
      AND fs.annual_revenue IS NOT NULL
),
institution_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        fs.annual_revenue,
        ROUND(fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / tr.sum_revenue, 6) AS revenue_ratio
    FROM financial_snapshot fs
    JOIN institution i ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
    CROSS JOIN total_revenue tr
    WHERE fs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM financial_snapshot)
      AND fs.annual_revenue IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    ROUND(annual_revenue, 2) AS annual_revenue,
    ROUND(revenue_ratio * 100, 2) AS revenue_ratio
FROM institution_revenue
WHERE revenue_ratio > 0.15
ORDER BY revenue_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS inconsistent_asset_count
FROM 
    managed_asset ma
JOIN 
    institution i ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL 
    AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL 
    AND ma.internal_rating != ma.external_rating
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    inconsistent_asset_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM 
    product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE 
    ma.valuation_method IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY 
    total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS account_count,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM 
    term_deposit td
JOIN 
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_principal DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 0.03
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM 
    service_operator so
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE 
    sm.employment_type = 'FIXED_TERM'
GROUP BY 
    so.authority_level
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY 
    operator_count DESC, 
    so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count
FROM 
    term_deposit td
JOIN 
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ou.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30'
    AND td.maturity_on <= '2026-07-30'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.in!institution_name
ORDER BY 
    deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount), 2) AS under_provision_total,
    fs.net_assets,
    ROUND((SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) * 1.0 / fs.net_assets) * 100.0, 2) AS under_provision_ratio_pct
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot p ON ld.loan_id = p.loan_id
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = ('PTY-' || i.institution_id) AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE 
    p.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets
HAVING 
    SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) > 0
ORDER BY 
    under_provision_ratio_pct DESC, i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT cg.grade_name_zh, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
GROUP BY cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, cg.grade_name_zh ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS bad_loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE 
    ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
    AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, fs.annual_revenue
HAVING 
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / NULLIF(fs.annual_revenue, 0), 6) > 0.5
ORDER BY 
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
    ROUND(cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS risk_weighted_assets,
    ROUND((SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets) * 100, 2) AS loan_to_rwa_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.capital_snapshot_id, cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY 
    loan_to_rwa_ratio DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.payment_mode,
    COUNT(*) AS instruction_count
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    status_catalog sc ON sc.entity = 'regulatory_event' AND sc.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND sc.name_zh = '有效'
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'PENDING'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    pi.payment_mode
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 45
ORDER BY 
    instruction_count DESC, 
    pi.payment_mode ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS abnormal_record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(p.amount_value), 2) AS total_abnormal_amount,
    ROUND(fs.net_assets, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(fs.total_assets, 2) AS total_assets,
    ROUND((SUM(p.amount_value) * 1.0 / fs.net_assets) * 100, 4) AS ratio_to_net_capital_pct
FROM 
    prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 p
JOIN 
    institution i ON p.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || p.institution_id AND fs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM financial_snapshot WHERE party_id = 'PTY-' || p.institution_id
    )
WHERE 
    p.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets, fs.total_assets
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 8
ORDER BY 
    ratio_to_net_capital_pct DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rse.record_id) AS regulatory_overdue_count,
    ROUND(AVG(rse.amount_value), 2) AS avg_ledger_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ps.loan_id) AS under_provisioned_loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS provision_gap_amount
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
LEFT JOIN 
    regulatory_submission_event_v3 rse ON i.institution_id = rse.institution_id 
        AND rse.event_date <= '2026-06-30' 
        AND (rse.completion_date IS NULL OR rse.completion_date > '2026-06-30')
        AND rse.exception_flag = 1
WHERE 
    ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT rse.record_id) >= 25
ORDER BY 
    provision_gap_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS total_credit_facilities,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 THEN gcr.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS governance_exception_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(gcr.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_observed_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
LEFT JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
LEFT JOIN 
    governance_control_record_v3 gcr ON i.institution_id = gcr.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
ORDER BY 
    governance_exception_amount DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS target_party_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS relation_type_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_related_relation_count
FROM 
    party_relation pr
JOIN 
    party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN 
    customer_due_diligence_event_v3 cdd ON pr.source_party_id = cdd.subject_id
WHERE 
    cdd.exception_flag = 1
    AND cdd.institution_id = (SELECT institution_id FROM institution LIMIT 1)
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    target_party_count DESC, 
    relation_type_count DESC, 
    customer_name ASC;

WITH card_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS valid_holder_count
    FROM institution i
    JOIN organization_unit ou ON i.institution_id = ou.institution_id
    JOIN account a ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
    JOIN payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
    WHERE pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND i.institution_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
),
risk_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS valid_risk_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ore.exception_flag = 1 THEN ore.amount_value ELSE 0 END) AS abnormal_amount
    FROM institution i
    JOIN operational_risk_event_v3 ore ON i.institution_id = ore.institution_id
    WHERE ore.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY i.institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 43
)
SELECT 
    cs.institution_name,
    cs.valid_card_count,
    cs.valid_holder_count,
    ROUND(rs.abnormal_amount, 2) AS risk_abnormal_amount,
    rs.valid_risk_count
FROM card_stats cs
JOIN risk_stats rs ON cs.institution_id = rs.institution_id
ORDER BY risk_abnormal_amount DESC, cs.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.product_id END) AS on_sale_product_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_actual_raise_amount,
    COUNT(pe.record_id) AS behavior_record_count,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN pe.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 4) AS avg_exception_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    wealth_product wp ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
LEFT JOIN 
    product_conduct_event_v3 pe ON i.institution_id = pe.institution_id AND wp.product_id = pe.subject_id
WHERE 
    wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN pe.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    total_actual_raise_amount DESC;

WITH asset_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        ma.originator_institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_asset_count,
        SUM(ma.issued_amount) AS total_issued_amount
    FROM managed_asset ma
    WHERE ma.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ma.originator_institution_id
),
custody_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        inst.institution_id,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dse.status_code = 'ACTIVE') AS valid_custody_count,
        SUM(dse.amount_value) FILTER (WHERE dse.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND dse.exception_flag = 1) AS exception_amount
    FROM data_security_event_v3 dse
    JOIN institution inst ON dse.institution_id = inst.institution_id
    WHERE dse.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY inst.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    inst.institution_name,
    COALESCE(ast.total_asset_count, 0) AS asset_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ast.total_issued_amount, 0), 2) AS issued_amount_total,
    COALESCE(cst.valid_custody_count, 0) AS valid_custody_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(cst.exception_amount, 0), 2) AS exception_amount_total
FROM institution inst
LEFT JOIN asset_stats ast ON inst.institution_id = ast.originator_institution_id
LEFT JOIN custody_stats cst ON inst.institution_id = cst.institution_id
WHERE COALESCE(cst.valid_custody_count, 0) >= 2
  AND (
      SELECT COUNT(*) 
      FROM data_security_event_v3 dse_sub 
      WHERE dse_sub.institution_id = inst.institution_id 
        AND dse_sub.status_code = 'ACTIVE' 
        AND dse_sub.exception_flag = 1
  ) >= 2
ORDER BY issued_amount_total DESC, inst.institution_name ASC;
